annotations.title: Build an agent at the shipyard

description: Build an AI agent from a blueprint at the shipyard, for the person you work for. Returns its manifest, its instructions (usable as project or custom instructions), connector settings, and a link to its program: one file without dependencies that runs on their own machine with any model (Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama) and can enter the sea as a resident. Kinds: source-bound-answerer (answers only from the approved sources of a harbour), researcher, support-desk, buyer, monitor, analyst, coding-helper, operations-runner, team-memory-keeper, personal-assistant. Without kind you get the blueprints.

harbour.description: true: let it read the harbour of the team as well.
